review_comment: The code reassigns DOM text content without sanitization when restoring previously truncated text. While textContent/innerText assignments typically treat content as plain text, ensure the original element content is properly sanitized before initial assignment. Consider validating that text properties contain only expected text content rather than HTML markup.

The code reassigns text content and inserts HTML without explicit encoding, but relies on textContent/innerText to sanitize input. To ensure safety, explicitly encode any user-influenced content before insertAdjacentHTML calls using textContent assignment or a dedicated HTML encoding function. Consider validating that text content doesn't contain HTML markup before processing.
